test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following insurance companies has launched the 'SheTARA' health campaign on International Women's Day, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Star Health and Allied Insurance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Star Health and Allied Insurance** launched the **'SheTARA' health campaign** on **International Women's Day 2025**, focusing on health awareness and empowerment for women.
 
• The campaign aims to address the **specific health needs of women**, such as maternal care, breast cancer awareness, and preventive healthcare.
 
• It is part of Star Health's initiative to promote **gender inclusivity** and create a platform for discussions on women's health challenges.
 
• Star Health and Allied Insurance is a prominent player in the health insurance sector in India, known for its **specialized health insurance products**.
 
• The campaign aligns with the company’s vision of strengthening women’s access to **quality healthcare and insurance solutions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Star Health and Allied Insurance:**

 
 
• Founded in **2006**, it is one of India's first standalone health insurance providers.
 
• It offers various health insurance products such as **family health plans, critical illness plans, senior citizen plans**, and more.
 
• Known for its extensive network of **hospitals and cashless treatment facilities**, Star Health focuses on customer-centric services.
 
 
 
• **International Women's Day:**
 
 
• Celebrated annually on **March 8**, it highlights the achievements and challenges faced by women worldwide.
 
• The theme for International Women's Day 2025 is expected to focus on **health equity and empowerment**.
 
 
 
• **Health Campaigns in India:**
 
 
• Government and private organizations frequently launch campaigns to address **public health challenges**.
 
• Examples include initiatives for **maternal health, cancer awareness, vaccination drives**, and more.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Women-Centric Health Campaigns:**
 
 
• Women face unique health challenges due to **biological and societal factors**.
 
• Campaigns like 'SheTARA' aim to improve **health outcomes and awareness among women**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Health Insurance Providers:**

 
 
• **HDFC ERGO General Insurance:** Known for its diverse insurance products including **health, motor, and travel insurance**.
 
• **United India Insurance Company:** One of the oldest insurance companies offering a wide range of **general insurance services**.
 
• **ICICI Lombard General Insurance:** A leading private-sector insurer providing **customized health and general insurance solutions**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Women's Health Awareness:**
 
 
• Improving women's health contributes to better **family and community well-being**.
 
• Focused campaigns help reduce **gender disparities** in healthcare access.
